title: The Interior of Room 214
author: Paloma Okonkwo
blurb: Rosalind Voss, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
